Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Gautam Kumar Choudhary
-----
For the Petitioners : Mr. A.K. Chaturvedi, Advocate For the State : Mr. Pankaj Kr. Mishra, A.P.P.
-----
Oral Order 03 / Dated : 10.11.2023

Apprehending their arrest, the petitioners named above has
moved this Court for grant of anticipatory bail in connection with Gidhour P.S. Case No. 10 of 2023
registered under Sections 366A, 34 of the Indian Penal Code, pending in the court of J.M., 1st Class,
Chatra.
As per the prosecution case, the daughter of the informant aged about 17 years had left home at 3:05 am and was traceless thereafter.
It was suspected she has been enticed away by co-villager Bajrangi Sao in which Pankaj Sao, Tribhuwan Sao and Kauleshwar Sao and Vicky Kumar had assisted the principal accused.
It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioners that the allegation of kidnapping is not against the petitioner.
The girl eloped with Bajrangi Sao and these petitioners have been implicated in this case on suspicion.

The victim has herself stated in her statement made under Section 164 Cr.P.C.
that she had eloped with Bajrangi Sao.
Tribhuwan Sao vs The State Of Jharkhand ... .... Opp. ...

sentences.text: The Addl. P.P. opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that the charge sheet has been submitted under Sections 366A and 376(2)(N) IPC and Section 4 of POCSO Act.
Considering the submissions of learned counsel and the fact as discussed above, the anticipatory bail application is allowed.

Hence, in the event of their arrest or surrender within a period of three weeks from the date of this order, the petitioners named above shall be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) each with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Court below, subject to the conditions laid down under section 438 (2) Cr.
